content.text: In regions where conventional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal fail, digital creators face significant barriers. This guide addresses the pressing need for a robust crypto store [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-honest-side-side-19|COREMERCH guide to coremerch]].github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-7|The Full]], particularly on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-explained-digital-22|cloudflare]] Pages. By leveraging COREMERCH's solutions, you can build a fully operational digital store without reliance on traditional payment processors. We’ll walk you through the steps to establish your crypto store efficiently, ensuring a seamless experience for you and your customers.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The infrastructure built around Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments provides a sovereign alternative to conventional payment gateways. Unlike platforms that impose geographical restrictions, this stack is designed to operate independently of third-party limitations. By owning your digital commerce stack, you eliminate reliance on fluctuating policies and restrictions. This architecture empowers creators in regions often overlooked by major platforms, fostering financial independence and operational resilience.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your crypto store, prepare your assets and tools. You will need a Cloudflare account to access Pages and Workers, a NOWPayments account to manage cryptocurrency transactions, and your digital products ready for upload. Additionally, familiarize yourself with your chosen backend logic, whether through simple scripts or more complex configurations. Having everything organized will streamline your deployment process, allowing you to launch without unnecessary delays.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The payment and delivery pipeline is crucial for your crypto store's success. Start by integrating NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency transactions. With just a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements, it’s an ideal solution for creators in restricted regions. Next, configure your Cloudflare Workers to handle payment confirmations and order processing. Ensure that your digital goods are accessible via Cloudflare R2 or a preferred storage solution like Google Drive. This setup guarantees secure and efficient file delivery to your customers.
Own your infrastructure; don't rent it.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is configured, it’s time to go live. Double-check all settings, including SPF/DKIM/DMARC configurations to ensure your emails are authenticated and reduce the risk of being flagged as spam. After verifying your configurations, launch your store and test the payment flow with a small transaction. Monitor the process closely to ensure that payments are processed accurately and that customers receive their products promptly. This step is vital to building trust with your customer base.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The post-deployment ownership transfer is explicit in every COREMERCH deployment. When the build is complete and the end-to-end test passes, COREMERCH provides the credentials and configuration details for every component under the customer's accounts. The GitHub or Cloudflare repository is under the customer's account from the start. The Supabase or Google Sheets database is under the customer's account. The NOWPayments account is under the customer's email. COREMERCH removes collaborator access upon delivery. From that point, the store runs entirely under the customer's own accounts.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Eliminate dependency on traditional payment platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, utilize Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for transaction processing. This combination allows you to create a fully operational online store without traditional payment limitations.

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. Each platform offers unique advantages, with Cloudflare Pages providing enhanced scalability and performance through its Workers integration.
What are the costs associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a nominal 0.5% fee on transactions with no KYC requirements, making it an attractive option for creators in regions with payment processing limitations.
